reason: Adds a Connected Apps settings section and client-side extension slot for other DSH plugins, with an explicitly empty default state and no registry or network transport.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板中添加“连接应用”区块，并提供供其他插件展示应用卡片的扩展插槽。
summaries.en: Adds a Connected Apps section to the DeepSeek Harness Settings panel with an extension slot for other plugins to display app cards.

capabilities: Adds a Connected Apps entry to the DSH Settings panel
Declares a client-side slot for other plugins to render app cards
Registers a placeholder host-side tool named dsh_authorize_app
